triplets.head: Deep learning calibration Paradigm A (inverse map)
triplets.tail: Train NN: Prices → θ; single forward pass at calibration time; extremely fast but less robust

triplets.head: Deep learning calibration Paradigm B (forward map + optimize)
triplets.tail: Train NN: θ → Prices; then optimize min_θ ||NN(θ) − Market||²; more robust and flexible; dominant in practice
